entities.summary: The Cyprian Norwid Theatre in Jelenia Góra is a Polish repertory theatre founded in 1945. The Norwid Theatre in Jelenia Góra has two stages: Main Stage and Studio Stage. The theatre is named after Cyprian Norwid. Cyprian Kamil Norwid Theatre is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1905. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
